The composite page covers **Region Hovedstaden** (the administrative and operational healthcare organization) and **Hovedstaden** (the geographical and statistical region designation used in reporting). Together, they represent the Capital Region of Denmark's role and performance within the national [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]]. Region Hovedstaden is one of Denmark's five regions, frequently highlighted in annual reports for its significant variations in ADHD diagnostic and treatment quality standards.

In terms of diagnostic volume, Region Hovedstaden and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] both experienced a 24% increase in the number of diagnostic pathways (udredningsforløb) registered in the database, serving as a benchmark against regions like [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] that saw declines [^src1]. The region actively contributes data to the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]], reporting on both the [[adhd-udredningspopulation|udredningspopulationen]] and [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|behandlingspopulationen]] [^src5]. For instance, the region recorded 2,321 diagnostic pathways and 647 patients in package pathways [^src5].

Performance across various quality indicators reveals a mixed landscape for Hovedstaden. For [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]], Hovedstaden achieved a 64% fulfillment rate, placing it among the best nationally [^src11]. It also recorded the highest fulfillment for [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] at [[36-percent|36-percent]] in the 2023 report [^src4], though later data showed regional results varying from 6% in Midtjylland to 29% in Hovedstaden [^src12]. For [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]], Hovedstaden and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] achieved 35% and 33%, respectively [^src8]. However, the region struggled with [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]], scoring significantly lower than other regions at 37%, a discrepancy largely attributed to registration difficulties within Region Hovedstaden rather than actual clinical performance [^src10]. Furthermore, no regions, including Hovedstaden, fully met the standards for [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]] [^src9].

The region also demonstrates distinct practices regarding clinical observations and interviews. For [[indicator-2b|indicator-2b]] (diagnostic interviews or environmental observations for 6-17 year-olds), Region Hovedstaden achieved a 46% fulfillment rate (95% CI: 44–49) in 2023/24 [^src3]. For the 0-5 age group (Indicator 2a), the fulfillment was 52% (119 out of 228) [^src2]. Notably, Region Hovedstaden and Region Midtjylland prioritized somatic examinations based on recommendations from the [[danske-multidisciplinaere-psykiatrigrupper-dmpger|Danske Multidisciplinære Psykiatrigrupper (DMPGer)]] [^src7]. 

Educational and social outcomes for youth in the region are relatively strong. The highest proportion of passed final exams among young people in the [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] was observed in Hovedstaden (63%), compared to the lowest in Nordjylland (47%) [^src13]. Similarly, for the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]], Hovedstaden led with 69% passing, against Nordjylland's 49% [^src13]. 

There are also notable regional variations in the use of specific pathway markers, such as [[agx01b|AGX01B]] [^src6]. Within the region, specific departments show unique performance metrics; for example, regarding [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]], results varied up to 4% in Hovedstaden at the regional level [^src14], and up to 9% at the department level, specifically at the [[pck-psykoterapeutisk-klinik|PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik]] in Hovedstaden [^src14]. Structurally, the psychiatric arm of the organization, [[rhp|RHP]] (Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri), is a core part of Region Hovedstaden, though reports note it has struggled to fulfill the database's indicator standards [^src6].

## Claims

### Region Hovedstaden
**quantitative**
- Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden havde begge en stigning på 24 % i antal udredningsforløb [^src1]

**statistical**
- Region Hovedstaden: 119 / 228 = 52 % opfyldelse af indikator 2a i 2023/24 [^src1]

**statistical-claim**
- Region Hovedstaden har en målopfyldelse på 46 % (95 % CI: 44–49) for indikator 2b i 2023/24 [^src1]

**regional**
- Region Hovedstaden har 2.321 udredningsforløb og 647 patienter i pakkeforløb [^src1]

**observational**
- Der er store regionale forskelle på hvor meget forløbsmarkøren AGX01B bruges [^src4]

**performance**
- Regionsresultaterne varierer fra 6 % i Midtjylland til 29 % i Hovedstaden [^src1]
- Hovedstaden og Nordjylland opnåede hhv. 35 og 33 % for Indikator 5 [^src1]
- Blandt afdelinger med minimum tre patienter i nævneren varierer resultaterne fra 0 % (på de fleste afdelinger) til 9 % (PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik i Hovedstaden) [^src1]
- Der er ingen regioner, der samlet set opfylder Indikator 10[^src1]
- Hovedstaden lå væsentligt lavere end de øvrige regioner med et resultat på 37 %[^src1].

**regional-variation**
- Den højeste andel af beståede afgangseksaminer blandt unge i ADHD-udredningspopulationen ses i Hovedstaden (63 %), mens den laveste ses i Nordjylland (47 %) [^src1]
- Den højeste andel af beståede afgangseksaminer blandt unge i ADHD-behandlingspopulationen ses i Hovedstaden (69 %), mens den laveste ses i Nordjylland (49 %) [^src1]
- Blandt regioner med minimum tre patienter varierer resultaterne fra 0 % i Sjælland og Nordjylland til 4 % i Hovedstaden [^src1]

**interpretive**
- Der ses relativt store regionale forskelle, men disse er formentlig hovedsageligt betinget af registreringsvanskeligheder i Region Hovedstaden[^src1].
